name: VibeRevise
appName: VibeRevise — fix the words, keep the file
appDescription: Edit the text of an HTML document and save it with the markup untouched.

site.title: VibeRevise — let AI rewrite it, keep what you fixed
site.description: Fix the words in an AI-made HTML document right on the page. When your AI tool regenerates the file, your fixes are carried over and its changes are highlighted for review.
site.eyebrow: For documents your AI tools write as HTML
site.heroTitle:
Let AI rewrite it.
Keep what you fixed.
site.heroLede: Codex, Claude and ChatGPT hand you reports, plans and pages as HTML. VibeRevise lets you fix the words right on the page — and when the AI regenerates the file, your fixes are carried across and everything it changed is highlighted for you to review.

pains.title: One wrong sentence, another prompt
pains.body: The draft is 95% right. The only way to fix the last 5% is to ask again and hope nothing else moves.

pains.title: The next run undoes your edits
pains.body: You fixed it by hand. Then the AI regenerated the file and your fixes quietly disappeared.

pains.title: Editing the HTML breaks it
pains.body: Open the file in a code editor, change a word, and a missing bracket takes the layout with it.

site.featuresTitle: Regenerate when you want. Edit when you need to.

features.title: Edit the words on the page
features.body: Click any text and type. Add a paragraph, bullet or table row, or make words bold or italic. The file you save is the one you opened with only those changes in it.

features.title: Your fixes survive a regenerate
features.body: When another tool rewrites the file, VibeRevise notices, brings the new version in and puts your unsaved fixes back. If you both changed the same words, it asks you which to keep.

features.title: See exactly what the AI changed
features.body: Changes made outside VibeRevise are highlighted on the page and listed. Mark them reviewed as you go, and hide the highlights when you’re done.

features.title: AI help, on your terms
features.body: Explain, rewrite, proofread or reply to a comment using your own AI key. By default AI only suggests — you make every change.

features.title: A list of every change
features.body: Every edit is listed with who made it, you or the AI and which model. Undo any one of them on its own.

features.title: Comments that travel with the file
features.body: Leave notes in the margin. They’re saved inside the HTML file as ordinary comments, so they go wherever the file goes.

steps.title: Open the file
steps.body: Open the HTML file your AI tool made, from your computer or a server on your network.

steps.title: Fix the words
steps.body: Click and type. Ask AI to explain or suggest when you want a second opinion.

steps.title: Regenerate freely
steps.body: Let your AI tool rewrite the file. Your fixes come back, and its changes are highlighted for review.

site.closingTitle: Keep the speed of AI. Keep your edits too.
site.closingBody: Free while we’re in beta. Nothing to install for the web app, and no account.

faqExtra.q: Does it work with Codex, Claude Code or Cursor?
faqExtra.a: Yes, with any tool that writes HTML files to your disk. Open the file in VibeRevise and leave it open while the tool works. VibeRevise checks the file every few seconds, tells you when it changes, and brings the new version in with your unsaved fixes kept.

faqExtra.q: What if the AI and I changed the same sentence?
faqExtra.a: VibeRevise won't guess. It shows both versions side by side and you pick which one to keep.
